newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Henderson Land mulls listing in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Henderson Land mulls listing in Tokyo.

text.p: Blue-chip Hong Kong property developer Henderson Land Development Co Ltd said it was considering a secondary listing in Tokyo Stock Exchange.

"The company is considering the possibility of a secondary listing of its shares on the Tokyo Stock Exchange to further promote the recognition of the company among Japanese banks, financial institutions and investors," Henderson said in a statement issued through the Hong Kong bourse.
However, the company said no definitive decision had been made to proceed or the timing and terms thereof.
"Further details will be announced by the company at the appropriate time if it is to proceed," it said.
A Japanese newspaper in Tokyo reported on Monday that Henderson Land is expected to list its shares in Tokyo as early as February.
Henderson Land would be the first Hong Kong firm and only the second non-Japanese firm in Asia to list shares on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, the report said.
The company's shares rose HK$1.50 to end at HK$77.75 a share on Monday.
